info.name: Acme Commerce API
info.description: Everything you need to sell: customers, orders, refunds, the product catalogue and webhooks. REST over HTTPS, JSON in and out, bearer-token authenticated.

item.name: Authentication (v2)
item.description: Exchange an API key pair for a bearer token, and revoke it when you are done.

request.description:
Exchanges an API key pair for a short-lived bearer token. Tokens expire after one hour; request a new one rather than caching indefinitely.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key_id` | string | yes |
| `key_secret` | string | yes |
| `scopes` | array | no |

response.name: 422 Unprocessable Entity

request.description:
Invalidates the token used to make this call. Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked token still returns 204.

Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

item.name: Webhooks (v2)
item.description: Receive signed callbacks when things happen in your account.

request.description:
We POST a signed JSON payload to your URL for each subscribed event. Verify the `X-Acme-Signature` header before trusting a delivery.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string<uri> | yes |
| `events` | array | yes |
